newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenyan coffee prices firm on new coffee crop.
newsitem.headline: Kenyan coffee prices firm on new coffee crop.

text.p: The first few offerings from the 1996/97 coffee crop attracted premium prices at the weekly Kenya coffee auction on Tuesday, auction officials said.
Grade ABs averaged $156 per 50-kg bag from $139 last week, grade AAs averaged $162 from $144 and grade Cs averaged $143 from $133.
"This week's auction had better quality of coffee on offer because of the new crop, compared to last week's which had plenty of miscellaneous coffee grades," a trader said.
The Coffee Board of Kenya said it sold all 19,282 60-kg bags of coffee it offered, compared to 22,580 bags sold last week.
